findings.issue: The serve-trip.py server caches rendered editor HTML per trip in memory. The cache is only invalidated on /api/save. Server process PID 1339911 started at 00:31 UTC. react_template.tpl was modified with drag handlers at 01:04 UTC. No /api/save was called for trip beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846 after the template change. The server continues serving the pre-patch HTML containing slot-drop divs WITHOUT drag handlers. The new onDragOver/onDrop/onDragEnter/onDragLeave handlers and onDragStart on card-candidates are NOT being served to users.

findings.fix_required: Cache invalidation only — no code change needed. Two options: (a) restart serve-trip.py (kill PID 1339911 and relaunch from /root/travel-planner with 'python scripts/serve-trip.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8770 --data-root data'), or (b) POST to /api/save for trip beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846 which triggers _invalidate_html_cache(trip_id). After invalidation, next GET to /trip/<id> re-reads template from disk and serves updated JSX with all drag handlers.
